Stop consuming caffeine around 5pm. Try not to drink much alcohol (more than 1 or 2 beers) in the evening. Go to bed at the same time every night. Even if all you do is lay in bed staring at the ceiling for hours you still have to go to bed at the same time every night. If possible stop using electronics (tv, cell phone, tablet) about thirty minutes before you go to sleep. Try to dim the lights thirty minutes before you go to sleep as well. When you go to sleep don't pick up your cell phone. Don't check your email or facebook. If you can turn off all the alerts and put it on silent then do that. Your bedroom should be as dark as possible. I would suggest investing in blackout curtains if the streetlight is shining in. The general rule of thumb is that if you can read a newspaper without turning on a light then your room is too bright. Try and keep the room you are sleeping in cool (between 68-70 degrees). If you find that noise is waking you up then invest in a white noise machine or a fan.

Set your alarm and get up at the same time every day. Once your up you need to turn on the lights. If possible go outside in the sun. If you drive to work try not to wear sunglasses during your morning commute. Your internal clock is partially regulated by the amount of light that filters through your eyes, so more light in the morning is always better. Try to eat something when you wake up. Preferably something not to heavy, because high fat or sugar foods might make you sleepy.
